headline: CFTC orders Kalshi to halt bets on Trump's speeches
summary: The CFTC ordered prediction-market platform Kalshi to stop letting users bet on what Trump will say in his speeches, saying the bets may violate the US ban on easily manipulated contracts; Kalshi's CEO complied but opposed the move.

claims.statement: The CFTC ordered Kalshi to stop letting users bet on what Trump will say in his speeches.

sources.quote: CFTC tells Kalshi to stop letting people bet on Trump's speeches
Trump admin orders Kalshi to halt wagers on what words Trump will say

claims.statement: Kalshi's CEO complied with the order but opposed it.

sources.quote: The prediction market platform's CEO has complied but opposed the move.

claims.statement: The CFTC says the bets may violate the US ban on contracts that can be easily manipulated.

discrepancies.explanation: Engadget attributes the order to the CFTC while Ars Technica frames it as coming from the Trump administration.
